definition_quote.value: "Practice of dietetics and nutrition" means the integration and application of scientific principles derived from the study of food, nutrition, biochemistry, metabolism, nutrigenomics, physiology, food management, and from behavioral and social sciences in achieving and maintaining health throughout the life span and in providing nutrition care services, including medical nutrition therapy, for the prevention, management, and treatment of disease.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of dietetics and nutrition" means the integration and application of scientific principles derived from the study of food, nutrition, biochemistry, metabolism, nutrigenomics, physiology, food management, and from behavioral and social sciences in achieving and maintaining health throughout the life span and in providing nutrition care services, including medical nutrition therapy, for the prevention, management, and treatment of disease.

value: monitoring and evaluation of nutrition care plans
nutrition support including ordering of parenteral and enteral nutrition
dietary and nutritional counseling and education
development and administration of nutrition care standards and systems
methods_authorized.quote: This term includes, but is not limited to, nutrition assessment; nutrition diagnosis; nutrition intervention; monitoring and evaluation of nutrition care plans; nutrition support, including the ordering of parenteral and enteral nutrition; dietary and nutritional counseling and education, including regarding food, nutrient and prescription drug interactions; and the development and administration of nutrition care standards and systems.

drug_authority.value: Licensed dietitian nutritionists and licensed nutritionists may order patient diets including therapeutic diets (oral, enteral, or parenteral nutrition therapy). Enteral and parenteral nutrition may only be ordered by licensees who additionally hold CDR registration, Certified Nutrition Support Clinician certification, or demonstrated competency; does not include prescribing controlled dangerous substances.
drug_authority.quote: A licensed dietitian nutritionist or licensed nutritionist may order patient diets, including therapeutic diets, in accordance with the provisions of P.L.2019, c.331 (C.45:16B-1 et al.). Therapeutic diets may include oral, enteral, or parenteral nutrition therapy.
